comparison.objective: Index an off-balance rotary table 90° and lock it with a pin; candidate tunes and setscrew-locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a gravity-loaded plate on station while inserting a pin versus counterhold a small damper, use a recessed hex key, fine-turn a collar, and iteratively test response.
comparison.success_condition: Plate reaches 90° and remains pin-locked; body gives no numeric angular/pin tolerances. Candidate requires two quantified dynamic stops plus witness-tested setting retention.
comparison.reason: Both include bimanual stabilization and locking, but indexing to a fixed pose does not test feedback-based damping adjustment or impact performance.
